evidence.quote: PK parameters of meropenem and H-4295 after [14C]meropenem 120 mg/kg IV
S03 | DOI 10.11250/chemotherapy1953.40.Supplement1_145 | Table 1 (Iba et al. 1992, dogs and monkeys)

Beagle dogs (male 15.2-17.5 kg, female 13.0-15.1 kg, ICI). Unlabeled meropenem (Sumitomo, Lot No. P239, purity 99%) dissolved in water for injection; [14C]meropenem (radiochemical purity >=98%) dissolved in that solution. [14C]meropenem 120 mg/kg single IV (dose volume printed "120 mg/kg/ml"). Plasma study: female dogs n = 3, sampling 5, 10, 20, 40 min, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 12 h; blood mixed at once with oxalate or heparin, then centrifuged.
Meropenem by HPLC; H-4295 (open-ring metabolite) by radioimmunoassay; 1- or 2-compartment analysis. Each value mean ± SE of 3 dogs.

findings.reason: F0003:S5:T1:A3 supplies 120 mg/kg single IV but also prints dose volume as "120 mg/kg/ml". That expression does not establish an administration volume. Bolus versus infusion, input duration and chemical dose basis are NOT_FOUND. This single-dose study cannot complete a separate repeat-dose regimen.
findings.needed_material: Source clarification of the printed dose-volume expression, chemical dose basis and IV input history. Preserve the printed values pending review; do not correct or infer them.

findings.reason: F0003:S5:T1:C9 and F0003:S5:T1:C10 contain "—" for H-4295 Vd and Cl. No supplied note defines the marker. Detection limits, censoring policies and substituted-detection-limit mean status are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: A source legend defining the em dash and any applicable assay-limit or summary-substitution metadata. Retain the marker without converting it to zero, BLQ or a numerical estimate.

findings.reason: Plasma, parent meropenem and H-4295 are distinguished in F0003:S5:T1:A3-A5. Total versus unbound basis and animal health or renal-function state are NOT_FOUND. Figure-only 14C curves do not supply total-radioactivity observations on this page.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed concentration-basis and animal-state definitions before combining or comparing quantities. Preserve meropenem, H-4295 and figure-only 14C as separate evidence.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE inputs include reported parameters, a single-dose regimen, sampling times and isolated text concentrations. F0003:S5:T1:A5 states that concentration-time curves are in Fig. 1 only and not digitized. Numerical curves, verified animal identifiers, cross-time sampling structure and potential holdout membership are NOT_FOUND in the supplied item.
findings.needed_material: Authorized concentration-time records or separately documented figure extraction, with study membership, experimental units, timing origin and sampling design. Carry text-only values separately for preparation confirmation; downstream PK work must assess sufficiency.

findings.reason: F0003:S5:T1:A4 establishes mean ± SE of 3 dogs for reported values. Arithmetic versus geometric mean, derivation of the SE, serial versus other sampling structure and measured-versus-estimated status of the isolated text concentrations are NOT_FOUND. No digitized points are supplied.
findings.needed_material: Source definitions for the summary statistic, SE derivation and sampling structure; extraction provenance and measured-versus-fitted curve identification if figure data are later considered.

findings.reason: MI014 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk; origin: main:/missing_information/items/13. Field: Support for individual PK variability. Impact: A defensible individual-variability basis for subsequent population predictions has not been established. This item provides mean ± SE of 3 dogs, without verified individual records or a defined interindividual variability measure. It does not resolve DRQ09 or establish absence of individual data elsewhere.
findings.needed_material: During PK work, assess available experimental units and variability evidence; record supported variability or the resulting limitation without manufacturing it from group summaries. Preserve parameter uncertainty separately from interindividual variability.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE: meropenem Cl 0.236 ± 0.02 l/h/kg and AUC 516 ± 41 µg·h/ml are reported in F0003:S5:T1:A10/B10 and A7/B7. Retain LITERATURE_REPORTED, NOT_RECALCULATED and NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED status. AUC bounds, exact clearance estimation method, dose basis and input duration are NOT_FOUND. H-4295 follows parent dosing, has reported exposure and an undefined Cl dash, and cannot inherit parent clearance.
findings.needed_material: If CL is selected, confirm parameter definition, exposure window, analyte-specific dose basis, input history and estimation method. Obtain formation/systemic-input information if metabolite clearance is pursued; do not derive it here.

findings.reason: F0003:S5:T1:A9/B9 reports meropenem Vd 0.224 ± 0.01 l/kg. Vd is not defined as Vss, Vz or Vc. Moment information, integration bounds and constant, varying or interrupted input history are NOT_FOUND. H-4295 Vd is an undefined dash.
findings.needed_material: If Vss is selected, obtain the exact published volume definition and method or source-backed time-course, moment and dosing-input information. Do not relabel Vd as Vss.

findings.reason: This item supplies dog disposition candidates and sex-specific weight ranges only. A supported T02 model, binding input, renal-elimination evidence, justified physiological relationships and translation uncertainty inputs are NOT_FOUND. Reported systemic Cl alone does not establish renal clearance.
findings.needed_material: Supported upstream model or parameter outputs and separately sourced body-size, binding, renal-elimination and physiological inputs for the explicitly considered translation approach. Retain species inclusion and exclusion comparisons for later assessment.

findings.reason: The body evidence describes a dog plasma study with female dogs n = 3 and a female weight range of 13.0-15.1 kg. Individual contributing weights and health state are NOT_FOUND. The source citation mentions dogs and monkeys, but this item contains no monkey body measurements or parameter records. Candidate coverage does not establish qualified species coverage.
findings.needed_material: Actual contributing study weights when required for body-size scaling, animal-state information and independent parameter-by-species review. Do not substitute the male range, typical weights or citation-level species mentions.

findings.reason: F0003:S5:T1:A5 reports H-4295 half-life 1.06 h, numerically matching the central value in C8 under T1/2 (h), while C8 additionally reports ± 0.01. Meropenem text gives terminal half-life 40 min and the table gives T1/2 0.67 ± 0.04 h; their units differ and the table phase is unstated.
findings.needed_material: Record the H-4295 text/table repetition for confirmation of parameter identity. Preserve meropenem text and table half-lives independently with their original units and phase definitions; do not convert or reconcile them at this stage.
